opening.argument: The speaker promotes an arbitrage bot as performing transactions automatically, presenting recurring income from that activity rather than merely describing a third-party platform. He says viewers can recharge funds or use a free credit to test the application, while claiming they can make recurring monthly earnings from transactions conducted by a robot. The promotion also offers commissions when referred users recruit others, extending through successive referral levels. The application is described as a leading and safe financial-management platform, reinforcing assurances about its legitimacy while the speaker solicits deposits and referrals. Taken together, the automatic-profit claims, encouragement to fund or test the application, and multi-level recruitment commissions establish a promotional scheme centered on trading-bot returns.
